text:
Priya: Morning all — quick deal-spotlight standup for Luma Health POC. What I did: demo with IT last night, they liked perf but pushed back on key custody + dedicated networking. Blockers: clarify HSM vs customer-managed KMS and SSO onboarding. Today: confirm answers, update SOW, and schedule onboarding call.

Evan: Checked infra details — Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS via our KMS-proxy pattern. HSM is only available with Private onprem package. I can share a sample KMS ARN and the template config. Ping @Lena for compliance specifics.

Lena: Quick note from Sec: we don't offer customer-managed HSM for hosted. For Private (VPC/on-prem) we support HSM integrations and can provide attestation. Need to confirm whether customer requires FIPS/HSM key-wrapping or just KMS. Also ask them to complete the security questionnaire before onprem access.

Sam: SE update: customer requested rotation policy + 7y audit log retention. Do we have standard contract language for log retention and key rotation frequency? If not, I can draft a clause.

Priya: :thumbsup: @Sam please draft the clause. Also they asked about IP allowlist + SSO (SAML). @Jorge do we have an SSO onboarding window next week?

Jorge: Yep — I can do Wed 2pm PT for SSO onboarding. Reserving a slot. For IP allowlist, ask customer for their source CIDRs and whether they need a peered VPC or static egress IPs.

security-bot: New doc created: /docs/security/kms-hsm-integration.md (internal). Attestation checklist added.

Evan: Dropping sample KMS ARN and example snippet for legal:
```
KMS ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef12-3456-7890-abcd
# example curl to test access
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/test
```

Evan: Also flagged a contract CR: CL-233 — Legal wants explicit key custody wording. @Priya can you confirm whether customer accepts provider-managed keys vs bringing their own?

Priya: On it — I'll loop in Legal and confirm today. Planning to send updated SOW by EOD with two options (provider-managed KMS + Private/HSM path).

Lena: If they require HSM attestation, we need NDA + completed sec questionnaire before granting onprem access. Heads up.

Sam: No blockers from demo infra side. I'll prep a one-pager runbook for onboarding call (network checklist, test prompts, perf expectations).

Priya: Thanks team. If you have any docs/templates, drop links here. /remind me to follow up in 24h.
